newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lurgi, Hoechst units to cooperate.
newsitem.headline: Lurgi, Hoechst units to cooperate.

text.p: Germany's Lurgi Oel Gas Chemie GmbH and Hoechst-owned Messer Griesheim said on Monday they had signed an agreement aimed at cooperating internationally in the production of gases, hydrogen and carbon monoxide.

Under the agreement, Messer Griesheim will set up and run gas production facilities on client premises, while Lurgi will build production plants for refineries, the chemical industry, the renewable commodity sector and others.
The two said in a statement the venture was expected to have annual turnover of some 50 million marks.
Lurgi is a unit of Metallgesellschaft AG.
